authorized_change.reason: Prevent repeated PastML rows from overwriting one another and silently converting ambiguous ancestral-state reconstruction into a falsely unambiguous nucleotide call.
authorized_change.rule: Aggregate all rows by node and site. For each node-site cell, retain the nucleotide when exactly one distinct A/C/G/T state is reported. Encode the cell as N when no nucleotide state or more than one distinct nucleotide state is reported.

required_validation: Existing toy implementation validation must still pass.
Add a focused PastML parser test with repeated rows.
The focused test must prove singleton states remain unchanged.
The focused test must prove multi-state node-site reconstructions become N.
The focused test must prove downstream branch-event normalization does not emit an event when either endpoint is N.
PastML source pin, version, command-line inference settings and benchmark truth must remain unchanged.

triggering_smoke_observation.observed_behavior: PastML can represent an ambiguous node-site reconstruction using multiple rows for the same node, with different non-empty states for that site.
